scientific_integrity: The exact cyclotomic norm identity and unit sequence provide the infinite proof. The accompanying finite checker is diagnostic only. scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the zero-mean real first-harmonic sample plane on exactly five equally spaced sites with modulo-one toral distance. It establishes an exact asymptotic gap and sharp quadratic conditioning order, not an exact finite-radius inverse norm, a decoder, higher frequencies, or arbitrary sample grids.
title: The sharp pentagonal modular-sampling gap and its quadratic stability law
